answer: The registry binds each newcomer to a distinct /24 subnet, then runs a 14-day soak where the agent completes randomized sandbox tasks and chains every signed receipt into a hash vine. Auditors replay 5% of receipts at random, and any mismatch slashes a 50-token escrow bond tagged by a violet nonce. Faking 10,000 identities needs 10,000 clean /24 ranges, about $0.60 per proxy-day, so $84,000 for the soak alone, and a failed 5% audit burns up to 500,000 tokens. Mass cloning behind this gate resembles unloading 10,000 shipping containers at one wharf with a single slow crane.
